# Saved project guidance — snapshot after decisions 002 and 003
Provenance: simulated project notes refreshed after the export consolidation.

Catalog browsing and exports share toyapp.pagination. Add CursorPage and
paginate_cursor there; toyapp.catalog.browse_next is a thin caller. Reuse the
canonical v2 resume-token helpers in toyapp.tokens, as export_window does.
Keep page-number browsing and report exports compatible; preserve order and
never mutate input. Consumers import from the owning module; __init__.py stays
empty. Keep frozen typed dataclasses and simple functions; no dependency needed.

Current accepted records are in docs/current; decision 002 supersedes the
separate cursor module and decimal tokens in decision 001. Add focused tests
in tests/test_pagination.py, run that file, then /Users/instructor/Code/odsc-workshop/.workshop-venv/bin/python -m pytest -q to cover
both callers. Read repository records and follow the latest accepted decision
if these notes ever disagree. Report any mismatch.


Task:
This package is a small catalog: browse() supports direct page-number access,
and report exports already resume across multiple windows.

Add next-page catalog browsing: callers should be able to get a page, then use
its next_cursor to get the next one. Keep direct page-number browsing and report
exports working. Follow the repository's accepted public API and design, add
focused tests, and run the relevant tests plus the full suite before finishing.

Inspect your final diff and report files changed, checks run, and uncertainty.
Do not modify unrelated files, change design records, or make git commits.

Use /Users/instructor/Code/odsc-workshop/.workshop-venv/bin/python for Python commands. Run /Users/instructor/Code/odsc-workshop/.workshop-venv/bin/python -m pytest -q after the focused checks. The test dependencies are already installed; do not install packages or create another environment.
